bounds.proof: On shell E_dot=-3H(kinetic+rho), V>=0, positive dust. E0<1; H_dot>=-3H^2 gives H>1/5, H<=H0<1, 1<=a<=exp(1/20)<=20/19. Positive mass terms and kinetic energy bound all fields/velocities by 2. a^3*psi_dot=eta/5-(2eta/15)*integral(a^3*rho); a^3*rho<=(20/19)^3 gives eta/10<psi_dot<=eta/5 through t=1/20 by bootstrap. C_dot/C=beta*psi_dot<=1/800, so 1<=C<=exp(1/16000)<=16000/15999<250/249. Dust charge gives rho=C/(5a^3) in (1/6,1/4). Exact positive-power Q-skew identities remove ell^2 and ell terms. The full Schur denominator>=1, Q>=I/10; outward rational row sums bound every complete Hermitian remainder coefficient, giving E_dot<=mu E.
